scope: Visible Windows/Tk windows; PostMessageW mouse/key messages addressed only to this process's exact artwork Canvas HWND. Original application bindings handle the events; passive Tk observers and scene state verify delivery. For mouse messages, SetKeyboardState supplies the receiving GUI thread's VK_LBUTTON state only while pumping each message, then restores it. Explicit app.frame(0 if stage.paused else .025) plus screen.update follows Stage's pause contract. No Stage.tick timer scheduling or live FPS measurement.
input_method: PostMessageW WM_LBUTTONDOWN/UP and WM_KEYDOWN/UP to owned Canvas HWND
mouse_state_protocol: SetKeyboardState updates only the receiving GUI thread's VK_LBUTTON state during each posted message; restored in finally. No global SendInput, mouse_event, keybd_event or SetCursorPos.
harness_diagnostic: Initial plain PostMessageW mouse attempt received no Tk click and failed. An isolated experiment confirmed receiver-thread button state was required by Tk 8.6.14; failed evidence retained at .work/butterfly-inputs/first-attempt-failed.json.
